verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents that Reversal and Refund transactions are delivered to the developer through the Adjustments endpoint, alongside the API for authorizing and adjusting transactions. That gives programmatic post-auth delivery for at least two of the four event types. Chargebacks appear only as a dispute-escalation process, not as programmatic events, and clearings are not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: clearing/settlement event delivery, chargeback webhooks, documented stable transaction identifiers linking auth to post-auth events, and independent corroboration.
